caseName: Mississippi Power & Light Co. v. Mississippi
caseNameFull: Mississippi Power & Light Co. v. Mississippi

opinions.text: Application for stay of judgment of the Supreme Court of Mississippi, presented to Justice White, and by him referred to the Court, granted pending the timely filing and disposition of the appeal by this Court. This order is further conditioned upon the posting of a good and sufficient bond, in manner and amount to be determined by the Supreme Court of Mississippi.
